Missouri State ranks 118th in the FBS averaging 68.8 penalty yards per game, compared to New Mexico State's 47th-ranked 49.4 per-game average. Both teams rank low in time of possession. Missouri State is 124th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:36, while New Mexico State's 129th-ranked average is 27:16. Belin led Missouri State with 225 yards on 19-of-35 passing (54.3%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Lair had 68 rushing yards on 17 carries, adding one reception for zero yards. Jmariyae Robinson put up 93 yards on six catches. New Mexico State fell to Liberty 30-14 on Nov. 7. Hedden threw for 256 yards on 19-of-29 attempts (65.5%) with two touchdowns and two interceptions.
